metadata.case_name: ZARIR KHALID v. GURUNG DURGA BAHADUR AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Information Technology consultant; sole director of Flex-IT Solutions Limited

injuries.description: lacerations, bruises, haematomata and abrasions over multiple regions (including the head, face, neck, both upper arms, both elbow joints, right axilla, left shoulder, left flank and lower back)
injuries.body_part: head, face, neck, both upper arms, both elbow joints, right axilla, left shoulder, left flank and lower back
source: Dr. Wong opined the Plaintiff sustained multiple injuries including lacerations, bruises, haematomata and abrasions over multiple regions (including the head, face, neck, both upper arms, both elbow joints, right axilla, left shoulder, left flank and lower back).

injuries.description: anterior dislocation of left shoulder joint with labrum and bone damages
source: He opined the Plaintiff suffered from anterior dislocation of left shoulder joint with labrum and bone damages.

injuries.description: bone spur over the inferior aspect of humeral head which is compatible with post-traumatic degeneration of the left shoulder joint
source: An x-ray of the left shoulder revealed a bone spur over the inferior aspect of humeral head which is compatible with post-traumatic degeneration of the left shoulder joint.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the shoulder or upper arm

manifestations.description: causing the Plaintiffs head to bleed.
residual left shoulder pain, stiffness and weakness will be permanent
Weakness in his left shoulder and limited movement in his left shoulder when compared to his right shoulder
He continues to suffer from headaches and needs to take pain killers on a regular basis
He used to play soccer, basketball, volleyball, judo and tennis. However after the incident, he has been unable to resume such activities and took up cycling instead.
aching discomfort or tiredness with prolonged desk or computer work

source: the Plaintiff requires intermittent symptomatic treatment for pain

comparable_cases.case_name: Chung Chi Wing v Secretary for Justice
comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff in that case was a fireman and, as a result of work related injuries, suffered an impinged tendon on his right shoulder. He was assessed to suffer a 16% permanent impairment of the whole person.

comparable_cases.case_name: Wong Ching Ha v Manbright Company Limited trading as Ngan Lung Restaurant
comparable_cases.injury_description: bone bruising and oedema in the posterior part of the head of the right humerus and supraspinatus tendonitis and early subacrominal bursitis. At the time of the trial, she continued to suffer from right shoulder pain.

comparable_cases.case_name: Wong Lai Man v Eastern Terminal Limited
comparable_cases.injury_description: mild head contusion with mild swelling, right AC joint dislocation, contusion of lateral epicondyle and olecranon process of right elbow with reduced elbow movement and right knee 1 cm laceration. At the time of trial the plaintiff suffered residual pain, weakness and stiffness in the right shoulder and arm.
